title: Supremacy of Christ
definition: The supremacy of Christ means that Jesus is above all things in rank, worth, authority, glory, and saving significance.
summary: Jesus is supreme over creation, the Church, salvation, and all powers.
christFocus: Christ is before all things, holds all things together, and is preeminent in everything.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The supremacy of Christ means He is not one spiritual figure among many. He is before all things, Creator of all things, Sustainer of all things, Head of the Church, firstborn from the dead, and reconciler through His blood.

Every doctrine finds its proper place under His supremacy. The Church must not place anything above Christ: tradition, preference, personality, politics, or power.

Christ is supreme now and will be openly confessed by all creation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often add Jesus to life without making Him supreme. This doctrine matters because Christ must have first place in everything.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Examine what competes with Christ's supremacy in your heart. Give Him first place in worship, obedience, mission, relationships, and hope.
